Signs you may need post-surgery rehabilitation physiotherapy

If any of these sound familiar, a home visit physiotherapist in Bongaigaon can assess you and start treatment without a clinic trip.

  • Stiffness and limited movement in the operated area
  • Weakness and muscle wasting after time in bed or a cast
  • Swelling around the surgical site
  • Difficulty walking, climbing stairs or returning to daily tasks
  • Low confidence to move the healing limb

Common causes of post-surgery rehabilitation

  • Joint replacement (knee, hip, shoulder)
  • Spinal surgery and disc procedures
  • Fracture fixation with plates, screws or rods
  • Ligament reconstruction (e.g. ACL repair)
  • Prolonged immobilisation after any major operation

How our home physiotherapy treats it

Following your surgeon’s protocol, your physiotherapist manages swelling, restores range of motion, and rebuilds strength through carefully progressed exercises. Gait and stair retraining returns you to independence, while scar-aware and wound-safe techniques protect the healing tissue at every stage.

Post-Surgery Rehabilitation physiotherapy in Bongaigaon — FAQs

Where can I get post-surgery rehabilitation physiotherapy at home in Bongaigaon?
PhysiOkhom matches you with a verified physiotherapist who does home visits across Bongaigaon, Assam, including New Bongaigaon, Chapaguri Road, Barpara, Abhayapuri and nearby areas. Pick a slot, share your address, and a clinician comes to your door.
Is home physiotherapy safe soon after surgery?
Yes — in fact early, guided movement is one of the best things for recovery. Your physiotherapist works strictly within your surgeon’s protocol, progressing you only as the tissue heals, which makes home rehabilitation both safe and effective.
What should I keep ready for a post-surgery home session?
Your discharge summary or surgeon’s instructions, any prescribed brace or walker, and a clear space to move. Your physiotherapist brings the clinical assessment and exercise plan to you.
Are the physiotherapists treating post-surgery rehabilitation in Bongaigaon verified?
